data.scope: Gated setup/mixed workload/cleanup. Stable single-member rooms include binary and Unicode names, private pairs have distinct rooms, health0 keeps a variable. Inspectors use authenticated HTTP or CBOR on a fixed per-worker interval, skipping missed ticks; every name, member count, field, ordering and complete response is verified. During churn, known churn rooms may appear with one member; quiescent snapshots before and after must contain exactly the stable rooms. Healthy traffic uses 64 cyclic private templates at args.private_payload_bytes (default 1 KiB) and 16-message windows; fanout remains 1 KiB; full sender/value/FIFO checked. Churn verifies welcome, exact 8-byte-counter self delivery, normal Close and EOF. All stable peers stay connected until the mixed workload ends; every close and final resource/counter/byte total is checked. Latencies include client-side verification and competing client tasks on separate CPU cores. Native CPU covers all mixed work, not an isolated cost per delivery. Loopback; WebTransport uses pinned TLS, legacy WebSocket is plaintext. Rates/heartbeat disabled, default queues. Event-boundary RSS is not continuous peak or allocated bytes. Profiles excluded from timing medians.

data.scope: Loopback. WebTransport uses pinned TLS and graceful stream close; legacy WebSocket uses plaintext and Close/EOF. Real connected CBOR users in small rooms. All live welcome IDs unique; every stable user routes a complete independently checked private ring message before measurement. Selected rooms send configurable payloads at staggered per-user deadlines. Optional additional rooms complete paced join/ring/Close/EOF cycles while the stable population remains connected. Inactive sockets answer heartbeat Pings. Full sender/body/sequence and exact counters checked. Round-trip includes client sending and verification; logarithmic quantiles are upper bounds. Scheduling lag and churn lifecycle measured separately. Authenticated management is polled during traffic. Every Close acknowledgement, EOF and room departure is checked. Process/descriptor/TCP or independent QUIC-connection scans are quiescent gates outside traffic. Global socket/slab measurements include both clients and unrelated machine activity; server RSS excludes kernel socket memory. Heartbeat policy and bounded message/queue/staging limits recorded in server_command.
